question.text: Why is Mark-to-Market essential for computing Incentive Fees?

answer.text: To capture true portfolio gains at current market prices, on which performance fees are based

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1 MTM discussion, MTM ensures incentive fees are computed on true current-price gains — not on historical cost. The Trap: Other options misinterpret the purpose. Cross-Exam Context: Core fund-accounting principle. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Without MTM, IM could be unfairly rewarded or penalised — insist on daily MTM for derivatives-heavy Cat III AIFs.
